text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
We've finished our errands, so... since we're already here,
why don't we grab a bite to eat together on the way back?
choice_data_list: Sounds good, what should we eat?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Prompted by her words, I looked it up on social media,
and the first thing that caught my eye was—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
'#WorldGourmetFestival' '#StreetFood'
'#WorldSpecialtiesGathered' ...along with those tags,
there are plenty of appetizing street food pictures.
choice_data_list: How about going to—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I hesitated just as the words were about to leave my mouth. She was an Umamusume striving daily to become a refined 'star' of the stage...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...What's the matter?
choice_data_list: (Maybe a classier restaurant would have been better...?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...No.
But maybe...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: My, there really are so many food stalls.
choice_data_list: (I worked up the courage and invited them...)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"'Authentic Chococcino direct from Belgium'...
...Fufu, such a rich sweetness."
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's really elegant.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Even though it's a food stall, it says "Authentic Wood-Fired Pizza"...
Whoa, it's real... It smells just like wood smoke...!
choice_data_list: So this is authentic flavor...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Huh, what is that...?
An insane amount of fries and—mussels...?
choice_data_list: Apparently it's a specialty from Mont Saint-Michel...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Mont-Saint-Michel... That—that sounds unbelievably chic...!
choice_data_list: You think so too, Luck...!?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Ah, this is it... This is the "authentic taste" of my hometown.
choice_data_list: (They're enjoying this more than I expected...)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
This shop's main branch is near my family's house.
Next time you visit, Trainer,
I can show you around—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...? What's that?
There's some real upbeat music comin' from over there...
choice_data_list: This melody... could it be—?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Huh, an impromptu live music show...
They even have events like that, huh.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
do ya know this band?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I used to listen to it a lot while studying for exams...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Huh.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Since we're here anyway, let's go listen closer to the front.
choice_data_list: Huh, are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's a band that holds a lot of sentimental value for me,
but compared to her taste, it's quite hectic—
or rather, feels a bit too rock-and-roll.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it obvious?
Come on, over this way.
—Oh, look, they're handing out penlights!

text_block_list.name: Sound of Guitar
text_block_list.text: (Vrrrroooooom!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Ah ha ha!! Trainer,
you actually have pretty good taste in music!!
choice_data_list: The 'surprisingly' part was uncalled for...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Mercy, have mercy!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I never thought yer were someone who was
more than just training and foolin' around...!

text_block_list.name: Band Vocalist
text_block_list.text: Are you ready to get hypeeeeed?!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaaaaaaaay!
choice_data_list: Yaaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Did I show a wee bit of an unseemly side
of myself just now, I wonder...? Ho-ho-ho.
choice_data_list: ...Thank goodness.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: I'm glad Luck enjoyed it too,

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I told her that when I first invited her, I was worried
I might just be dragging her into my own personal interests."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: My taste, you ask...? Trainer, is that the kind of thing you like?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Like a food festival, street food stalls,
or rock music?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not just food, but I really like events like that
because you encounter things you'd rarely come across
in ordinary daily life...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The music whose fierce melody blew away the gloom
of grueling study sessions for exams
is something I still listen to often."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I had no idea at all.
...Even though we've spent quite a lot of time together.
choice_data_list: ...Same here.
...Same here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Until just a moment ago, I had no idea she was an Umamusume who could enjoy festival food and rock music with such pure, unrestrained passion.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Well, that's...
Yeah, you're right.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Turns out we get along pretty well after all, huh?
choice_data_list: Let's go somewhere you'd like next time, Luck.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"After all, we're two of a kind.
Just as she enjoyed today, I'm sure I will too."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
We... already went to that, didn't we?
Like that designer brand exhibition the other day.
choice_data_list: There are some that aren't 'like that' too, right?
There are some that aren't 'like that' too, aren't there?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Well, yeah, I do.
choice_data_list: Alright, let's decide when to go!
I want to know more about 'that sort of thing'
Let's tell each other more about what we like.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Hold your horses!
You're so fast I thought this was a sprint GⅠ!!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Well, can't hurt to be quick, right?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Hold on a sec.
I bookmarked a bunch of spots on UmaStagram that caught my eye...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Well now, aren't you leaning right into it.
choice_data_list: I want to understand you much better.
I want to understand you much better.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*...
You really go and say those things with absolute honesty, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...I really can't match up to ya.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...Fair enough, then. We're even.
Hehe, what're ya gonna teach me?"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Food, music... and next would be—favorite comedian?
Nah, forget that. Pretend I didn't say it."
